items.name: Vogita
items.cardSummary: Vogita is a boss entry for Planet Namak Act 1 with catastrophic danger level. The source lists no special ability or mutator for this entry.
items.quote: It's amazing how every time you open your mouth, you manage to prove you're an idiot. Are you ready now to witness a power not seen for thousands of years?
items.description: Vogita, the Prince of all Saiyans, was once a sought-out enemy but is now an ally, helping the Super Warriors against Friezo's villainous scheme.
